name: What are the pros and cons of investing in short-term rentals versus long-term rentals in popular tourist areas?

mainEntity.name: What are the pros and cons of investing in short-term rentals versus long-term rentals in popular tourist areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Investing in short-term rentals in popular tourist areas like Miami Beach or Fort Lauderdale Beach can offer higher potential income and flexibility, but often comes with more intensive management, fluctuating occupancy rates, and stricter regulations. Long-term rentals typically provide more stable income and lower turnover costs, though with potentially lower per-night rates. A practical tradeoff to consider is the amount of active management you are willing to undertake versus the stability of income. Kelby Contreras can advise on the regulatory landscape for short-term rentals in specific areas, which can vary greatly even within the same county.
acceptedAnswer.description: Short-term rentals offer higher income potential but require more management and face stricter regulations; long-term rentals provide stability. Kelby Contreras advises on regulations for specific areas.
